description: This is a PHP source file defining the IndexController class for the Goteo web application. It handles the homepage logic, including fetching projects, stories, banners, footprints, and other related data to render the home page view.

classes.name: IndexController
classes.description: Controller class for handling the homepage, extending DiscoverController, responsible for gathering data and rendering the home page view.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets database replica and cache, and sets the view theme.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles the main action for the homepage, fetching projects, stories, banners, footprints, stats, sponsors, and announcements, then rendering the 'home/index' view.

methods.name: getSponsors
methods.description: Retrieves sponsors grouped by their types.
